_comment: Risk indicators are NOT tax conclusions. They tell the reviewer where to look. Thresholds and categories are editable. 'adj_key' links a category to a row of the tax computation; an adjustment is only ever PROPOSED until a person approves it.

categories.label: Entertainment / hospitality
categories.implication: Entertainment, amusement and recreation provided to customers, shareholders, suppliers or business partners is generally restricted to 50% deductibility; staff-only entertainment may be treated differently.
documents: Split between staff and external guests

categories.label: Gifts
categories.implication: Gifts may be entertainment (50% restriction), donations (non-qualifying recipients are non-deductible) or deductible business promotion depending on recipient and nature.
documents: Recipient and purpose of each gift

categories.label: Donations / charitable
categories.implication: Donations are deductible only where made to a Qualifying Public Benefit Entity; otherwise non-deductible.
documents: Recipient name and proof of Qualifying Public Benefit Entity status

categories.label: Fines and penalties
categories.implication: Fines and penalties are generally non-deductible, other than amounts awarded as compensation for damages or breach of contract.
documents: Notice or order giving rise to each fine/penalty

categories.label: Personal / owner expenses
categories.implication: Expenditure not incurred wholly and exclusively for the business, and amounts withdrawn by owners, are generally non-deductible.

categories.label: Miscellaneous / general expenses
categories.implication: Catch-all accounts frequently hide non-deductible or undocumented items.
documents: Breakdown of the account by nature

categories.label: Legal, professional and consultancy fees
categories.implication: Check business purpose, capital nature (e.g. acquisition/structuring costs), related-party payees and arm's-length pricing.

categories.label: Commissions, incentives, promotion and marketing
categories.implication: Deductibility requires a business purpose and documents; payments to related parties, owners or for entertainment may be restricted.

categories.label: Repairs and maintenance
categories.implication: Check for expenditure of a capital nature that has been expensed.

categories.label: Related-party balances / transactions
categories.implication: Transactions with Related Parties and Connected Persons must be at arm's length; non-arm's-length amounts are adjusted. Disclosure and transfer-pricing documentation obligations may apply.

categories.label: Shareholder / director current account
categories.implication: Check for owner withdrawals, personal expenses, interest charged or benefits, and whether the balance is really a liability.
documents: Movement summary with nature of each item

categories.label: Interest and finance costs
categories.implication: Net interest is subject to the general interest deduction limitation; related-party and shareholder loans carry additional restrictions; check interest on loans used for exempt income.

categories.label: Provisions, impairments and bad debts
categories.implication: Treatment depends on the realisation-basis election and the nature of the provision; unsupported provisions may be restricted.

categories.label: Taxes and statutory charges
categories.implication: Corporate Tax, recoverable input VAT and foreign taxes on income are non-deductible (a foreign tax credit may be available instead).

categories.label: Foreign / withholding taxes expensed
categories.implication: Tax on income imposed outside the UAE is non-deductible; a foreign tax credit may be claimed instead, limited to the UAE tax on that income and supported by proof of payment.
documents: Income to which the tax relates

categories.label: Dividends and gains on shares (possible exempt income)
categories.implication: May qualify as exempt income (dividends from resident persons; participation exemption) or as Qualifying Income of a QFZP - only if all conditions are met. Related expenses are not deductible.

categories.label: Fair value / unrealised movements
categories.implication: Unrealised gains/losses are taxable by default; with a valid realisation-basis election only realised amounts are taxed (scope depends on the election). Items must be classified as capital or revenue.
documents: Copy of the realisation-basis election and first-period return
Opening and closing fair values by investment

categories.label: Foreign exchange differences
categories.implication: Realised vs unrealised split matters under the realisation basis; FX on interest is treated as interest for the limitation rule.
documents: Split of realised and unrealised FX
